programme.title: Дневники Темного
programme.desc: Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Explores the controversial theory that extraterrestrials have visited Earth for millions of years. From the age of the dinosaurs to ancient Egypt, from early cave drawings to continued mass sightings in the US, each episode gives historic depth to the questions, speculations, provocative controversies, first-hand accounts and grounded theories surrounding this age old debate. Did intelligent beings from outer space visit Earth thousands of years ago?

programme.title: Rome: Rise & Fall of an Empire
programme.desc: Despite the Empire's successes, the extensive military campaigns begin to take their toll on Rome's finances. When Dacian tribes ravage Roman lands, the unpopular Emperor Domitian is forced to raise taxes. He has never been on the front lines himself, but one of his generals, a young man named Trajan, soon proves to be a worthy leader while battling Germanic tribes on the Rhine. After Domitian's murder, Trajan is proclaimed emperor and sets out to rebuild the troubled Empire. He solves its financial problems by attacking the Dacian chieftain, Deceblas, uncovering his golden treasures, hidden in a river. In 106 AD, Deceblas flees, but Trajan's men hunt him down, only to find that he has killed himself to avoid the humiliation of defeat. Trajan's victory is immortalized in Trajan's Column in Rome, and under his reign, the Empire reaches its maximum extent of power.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: Lost Relic Hunters
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: An explosion in a San Bruno, California neighborhood destroys homes and kills residents. An experienced captain and crew sail their ship into the path of Hurricane Sandy, leaving many asking why? A building full of 3,500 garment workers suddenly collapses and traps many of them inside. A warehouse full of fireworks goes off without any warning, causing evacuations and deaths. And trains arriving at the same place at the same time end up colliding… was it an engineering failure or human error?

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: The Best of MonsterQuest
programme.desc: The MonsterQuest team is investigating sightings of dangerous ape like creatures across North America. Are these apes in the wild or a mysterious legend that stalks forests and swamps?

programme.desc: Theories of how the world will meet its end in this doomsday documentary as we follow scientist Trevor S. Valle as he hypothesises with others through the series. programme.title: Lost Gold of WW2
programme.desc: It is the last great mystery of WWII. The fabled Yamashita Treasure, a massive stash of gold bars and rubies worth billions, reportedly dumped in a cave by Japanese soldiers retreating from allied forces. While the fortune has become a legend, many experts claim there is no evidence it ever existed. Now, a dedicated group of investigators are resurrecting the dangerous search, using cutting-edge technology in pursuit of the truth, and unimaginable wealth.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: Engineering Disasters
programme.desc: Engineering has built our modern world. Everything from skyscrapers to roads and air travel exist because of advances in engineering. What happens when engineering goes horribly wrong? Engineering Disasters goes beyond the headlines to uncover what really happened in the most notorious engineering accidents. What caused an outdoor stage to collapse in Indiana, killing seven? How did a collection of classic Corvettes disappear right out of thin air? Why did a plane's fuselage rip open in mid-flight? What was behind the collapse of a domed stadium? Each hour long episode combines expert and eyewitness interviews, state of the art graphics and dramatic 'moment of disaster' footage to tell the story behind the world's most terrifying engineering disasters.

programme.title: Ancient Top 10
programme.desc: Ancient Top 10 is smart, fun countdown that details how ancient technology worked, how surprisingly advanced it was, and how it was kind of awesome. Location shooting, CGI, and graphics are pulled from past History series Ancient Impossible and Ancient Discoveries, and lists are organized by themes. The stories are augmented by new entries fueled by the History archive. Episodes include updated "Top Ten" graphics and new interviews that provide "wow" facts and explain why something made the list. The lists will have organizing principles so it doesn't seem arbitrary. Episodes could include the following: Top 10 Secrets of Egypt, Top 10 Ancient Vikings, Top 10 Greek Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Weapons, Top 10 Ancient Monuments, Top 10 Ancient Ships, Top 10 Torture Devices, Top 10 Roman Inventions, Top 10 Ancient Swords, and Top 10 Ancient Sieges.

programme.title: The Best of MonsterQuest
programme.desc: Something strange is killing animals and sucking the blood from its victims. Is this creature the mysterious Chupacabra of legend, or a gruesome new hybrid mutation?

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Утренняя новостная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Aвторский проект Вадима Кондакова. Это получасовые документальные истории о местах и людях, о которых мало кто знает. И которые станут для зрителя настоящим открытием. Автор побывал в самой самой западной точке страны, в Калининграде, где люди, без света и воды, живут в казематах заброшенного немецкого форта XIX века. И на далеких Курильских островах, в городе-призраке, про жителей которых почему-то забыли на материке. Кроме того, "Неизвестная Россия" расскажет о том, что за таинственный сигнал из космоса поймали в астрофизической обсерватории Нижнего Архыза. И можно ли стать дорожным полицейским, если ты родился в городе дальнобойщиков. В общем, "Неизвестная Россия" показывает страну такой, какой ее не знают даже сами россияне.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. Чарли только и делает, что заводит любовные интрижки, а Алан всеми силами пытается от него не отстать. В свободное от амурных приключений время братья воспитывают десятилетнего сынишку Алана Джейка.

programme.title: Два с половиной человека
programme.desc: Закоренелый холостяк Чарли, постоянно опасающийся за свою свободу, и его брат Алан, недавно разошедшийся с женой, живут под одной крышей. programme.title: Ивушка плакучая
programme.desc: Надя Краснова никогда не отчаивается и не сдается под натиском проблем, именно поэтому мама называла ее \"Ивушка плакучая\". У Нади одна цель в жизни — поднять и воспитать свою единственную дочь Полину. Но девушка не уважает мать и презирает ее образ жизни, мечтая о красивой жизни и богатом муже. Однажды Полина исчезает без следа. Вместе с ней пропадает и ее подруга по техникуму Люба. Полиция занимается поисками девушек, но и Надя не может сидеть сложа руки. Она решает объединить усилия с отцом Любы — Валерой. Несмотря на неприязнь друг к другу, они ищут дочерей вместе.

programme.title: Пуанты для Плюшки
programme.desc: Несколько лет назад Наташа была балериной. Теперь же она весит больше 90 кг, а муж называет ее \"Плюшкой\", - как из-за лишнего веса, так и из-за пристрастия к сладостям \"от Сергеича\". Съедая любимую плюшку, она нет-нет да пожалуется нарисованному на упаковке \"Сергеичу\" на скучную работу, отсутствие детей, неработающего мужа. И Сергеич всегда ее понимает. После встречи с бывшей наставницей жизнь Наташи круто меняется - ей предлагают преподавать балет. После первого же занятия Наташа встречает настоящего Сергеича - он пришел за своей дочкой, которая занимается в ее группе. И скоро Наташа понимает, что это - настоящая любовь. Но что ей делать с мужем и планами завести ребенка, а также со своими комплексами и лишними килограммами?

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Экстрасенсы ведут расследование
programme.desc: 6 сезон шоу \"Экстрасенсы ведут расследование\", в котором люди со сверхспособностями помогают полиции и частным детективам найти ответы на сложные вопросы, раскрыть настоящие преступления и докопаться до истины.

programme.title: Балтия
programme.desc: Еженедельная информационная программа "Балтия" – непредвзятый взгляд на происходящее в Эстонии, Латвии и Литве. События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. Точная и беспристрастная информация, все точки зрения о происходящем в каждой из трех стран, входящих в Евросоюз и военный блок НАТО.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Беги
programme.desc: Вор-медвежатник Саша проникает в дом, где становится свидетелем преступления: хозяин дома Чернов убил свою жену. Чернов начинает преследовать сбежавшего свидетеля. А Саше тем временем надо успеть приехать на утренник к сыну, ведь от этого зависит будущее его брака, который он всеми силами пытается спасти.

programme.title: Голое влечение Италия
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Пентагон
programme.desc: Проект Андрея Лошака. Лене удалось устроиться в службу поддержки онлайн-банка, купить квартиру в кредит и уехать из "Пентагона". Тетя Наташа твердо решила никуда не уезжать и ни на что не жаловаться: "Не трогают они нас и не трогают. Как говорится, выше власти всё равно не прыгнешь". Бурное празднование Нового года в "Пентагоне" закончилось скандалом, после которого оператор Александр досрочно покинул проект.

programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.desc: He's not messing around: Richard Quest presents his hot takes on the biggest breaking stories in the world of business. Joined by a cast of experts and correspondents delivering unrivaled facts and news, but also features and fascinating takes, figures and analysis on everything going down in the world of business.

programme.title: The Lead with Jake Tapper
programme.desc: CNN's chief Washington correspondent, Jake Tapper, hosts this hour-long weekday afternoon program, which covers all the day's top stories from around the country and the world, headlines that span politics, money, sports and popular culture. 'The Lead' works to ensure that viewers are caught up on the stories that matter, often highlighting news that may have been overlooked. Prior to joining CNN, Tapper served as senior White House correspondent at ABC News.

programme.title: World Sport
programme.desc: One of the CNN's longest running programmes that allows viewers to find out all the global sports news, see all the important events and most interesting parts, and enjoy the interviews with sports pundits and various sports stars.

programme.title: The Brief with Jim Sciutto
programme.desc: The best of CNN's reporting from correspondents across the world, to guide global audiences through the fast-paced news cycle with insight, analysis and hard-hitting interviews.

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons discover a family of cartoon copycats who mimic their every move. / Grandpa Louie has a new online friend - the only problem is she isn't real. / The kids find out that Richard has been being picked on by the same person since high school. / Gumball and Darwin decide to use online reviews to wrangle free stuff. / A mysterious package shows up at the Watterson's house and they do their best to avoid opening it. / Darwin likes a girl in his class so Gumball decides it's time to play cupid. / Gumball's smart answers aren't the correct ones and he's forced to go back to kindergarten. / Gumball and Darwin discover the real reason Dad's diet wasn't working. / Gumball discovers that Rob his old nemesis is neme-seeing someone else now.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: When Grandpa Louie gives them a cheque, the Watterson kids argue over how to spend the money. / When they find Anais training herself for a brutal showdown Gumball and Darwin realise that their sister is being pestered at school by an annoying kid: Billy. / An impromptu hug with a stranger at school leaves Gumball in an increasingly awkward social situation. / Mom and the kids depart for their hard day's work leaving a seemingly lazy Dad half-asleep on the sofa. Mom has given him one very simple job: buy mayonnaise. Director: Mic Graves,.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons' search for a parking space at the mall takes a little longer than expected. When the Wattersons arrive at the mall for a day of shopping, they struggle to find a space in the parking lot. They search for a space everywhere -- using all their intelligence, cunning and trickery -- but as the day goes on, the desperate hunt for a space becomes more important than the trip to the mall itself.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin see an advert for the latest, cutting-edge Bobert operating system and excitedly talk Bobert into downloading it. At first it seems like a massive improvement, but the many flaws in the new operating system become increasingly apparent. After the upgraded Bobert malfunctions one too many times, the kids decide to reinstall his old operating system. But will they be able to downgrade from the upgrade and get their old friend back?

programme.title: Lana Longbeard

Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

Tamm , Kairi Närep jt.

programme.title: Kaks kanget Jaapanis
programme.desc: Kaks Kanget tutvuvad riisikasvatuse põhitõdedega. Kristjan teeb kindlaks, kas kasutatud Jaapani autodel võiks olla Eestis turgu. Teejuht Riho-Bruno Bramanis näitab Teedule ja Kristjanile oma kunagist kodumaja. Ja räägib, mis asjaoludel ta Hiroshima Wakunaga käsipallimeeskonda sattus. Kaks kanget sõidavad Miyajima saarele piknikule, kus neid ründavad metsikud hirved. Teet võidab kasiinos palju raha. Mehed sukelduvad Hiroshima ööellu ja satuvad tüüpilisse Jaapani korterbaari.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Kristina mõistab, et ema kaudu ta bossile südamesse ei jõua, sest boss peab teda seetõttu oma ema eakaaslaseks. Miša jääb pealtkuulamislutikat paigaldades napilt Kristinale vahele ja tema salaagenditöö muutub järjest ohtlikumaks. Laura saab ülesandeks filmida firmast klipp millega investoreid ligi meelitada ja ta saab kodus šoki, kui avastab, et Chris on kutsutud oma totaka blogiga telesaatesse ja mees kogub kiiresti fänne. Samal ajal on aga Mariale modelli-kuulsus pähe löönud ja tüli Lauraga ainult süveneb.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Relika on segaduses oma lapse isaduse küsimuse pärast ja peab isadustestiks salaja Urmase DNA'd saama. Uus patrullija Veronika ja tema partner Sile jagelevad mõjuvõimu pärast oma meeskonnas. Politseijõude tabab aga spiooniskandaal ja mängu tuleb poliitbroilerist Siim-Sander Vahur. Rein peab uuesti vana vaenlasega silmitsi seisma. Rein läheb perega oma naise vennale Kuunole külla, kes on nüüd turundusärist väljas ja tegeleb ökomajandusega. Hans-Kristjan võitleb oma öötöö pärast pideva unega ja otsustab jaoskonnast lahkuda, sest tunneb, et on Reinu alt vedanud.

programme.title: Yellowstone
programme.desc: Kõrgelt hinnatud vestern, kus Ameerika suurima rantšo peremees John Dutton (Kevin Costner) peab koos perega kaitsma oma valdusi kõigi vastu, kellega nende maa-alad piirnevad. Duttoni pere maid ihkavad nii laienev linn, indiaanlaste reservaat kui ka Ameerika esimene rahvuspark.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Laura on stressis, sest kõik teised teostavad tema unistusi. Chris on edukas blogija, Maria on edukas modell, aga tema ise ei saa millegagi hakkama. Kristina on otsustanud taktikat muuta ning käitub ja riietub nüüd nagu teismeline, et bossile nooremana näida. Ta sõidab rulluiskudel ringi, kuni käib jube pauk. Laura avastab, et Chrisil on palju himuraid naisfänne tekkinud ja ilmneb uus oht. Miša peab Mariale südant puistama ja Maria saab teada, et Miša teeb koostööd politseiga, et boss vahele võtta.

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Reinu ja mõjuvõimsa advokaadi vaheline arusaamatus süveneb, sest salakaval Urmas Viil kasutab juhust ja valab õli tulle. Salaja öösel lisaraha teenimiseks burgereid müünud Hans-Kristjan on endas pettunud ja tahab töölt ära minna. Samal ajal tahab Reinu naine uue korteri osta ja Rein peab koos naisega laenu võtma. Relika ema kutsub Ukrainast Gregori kohale, et see Relika lapse eest vastutaks, Relika pole aga veel isadustesti tulemusi kätte saanud, ega tea, kas Gregori üldse millegi eest vastutama peaks. Ministeerium üritab nüüd Reinu ja võimuliitu kuuluva advokaadi tüli lahendada ja pakub välja, et Rein astuks parteisse ja osaleks kohalikel valimistel. Alternatiiviks oleks juhataja kohast loobumine. Kas Rein läheb diilile välja ja sumab poiliitikasse?

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.desc: Meelelahutusliku saate külaline on Tiit Made. Saatejuhid Kärt Karpa ja Tiina Kimmel.

programme.title: Jaak Joala tähtkuju
programme.desc: Eesti läbi aegade suurima popmuusiku ellu mahtus mitme saatuse jagu nii silmipimestavat tähesära kui ka sügavat inimlikku traagikat. Laulja 65. sünniaastapäevaks valminud monumentaalne saade sisaldab intervjuusid inimestega, kes teda kõige lähemalt tundsid ning hulgaliselt ka unikaalseid video- ja seniavaldamata fotomaterjale. Autor Vahur Kersna, režissöör Andres Lepasar, produtsent Ruth Heinmaa. 26. juunil on Jaak Joala 70. sünniaastapäev.

programme.title: Elmar TV
programme.desc: Raadiost Elmar tuttav Eesti muusika kullafond ja ka värsked kodumaised hitid hoiavad Eesti Kanalis öösiti tuju üleval. Nostalgitse või laula kaasa, kodumaiste muusikavideote paremik on eetris!

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.desc: Hiljuti leseks jäänud arhitekt Sam Baldwin kolib koos kaheksa-aastase poja Jonah'ga Seattle'isse. Aasta hiljem, jõululaupäeval, helistab Jonah raadio jutusaatesse ja veenab isa otse-eetris rääkima oma igatsusest lahkunud abikaasa järele. Tuhanded naised üle riigi kuulevad seda ja loost puudutatuna, kirjutavad Samile. Kirjutab ka ajalehereporter Annie Reed, kes pakub Samile välja kohtumise sõbrapäeval Empire State Buildingu katusel. R: Nora Ephron. O: Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan, Ross Malinger, Bill Pullman. Romantiline komöödia. Kahe Oscari nominent.

programme.title: Eriliselt kangelaslik film
programme.desc: Üks tavaline abiturient omandab ootamatult üleloomulikud võimed. Endine hädavares, kes on loomult heatahtlik ja abivalmis, otsustab hakata superkangelaseks. Nüüd hakkab ta võitlema kurjusega.

programme.desc: Animafilm

programme.title: Komandör Taylor
programme.desc: USA 2008 komöödia Lavastaja: Steven Brill Osades: Owen Wilson, Alex Frost, Casey Boersma, Steve Brill Juba esimesel koolipäeval satuvad kolm innukat uustulnukat, tüse Ryan, ebainimlikult kõhn Wade ja nende tagasihoidlik kannupoiss Emmit, kooli suurima psühhoterroristi Filkinsi (David Dorfman) märklauaks. Selleks, et nende senise elu parimast aastast ei saaks elavat põrgut, otsustavad poised palgata endale… ihukaitsja. Võimalike kandidaatide seast jääb sõelale Komandör Taylor (Owen Wilson), kes pole küll parim, kuid on see-eest odavaim. Ta on terasest lihastega, vilunud salaoperatsioone läbi viima ning oskab kõikvõimalikke võitluskunste. Tegelikult on ta lihtsalt suur jutumees ning varsti on poistel selge, et hoopis nemad peavad aitama Tayloril meheks saada…
